notes.title: SkydiVeR is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are super excited to announce that SkydiVeR is available now on Steam for VR, at the discounted launch price of [b]$4.49 for the first week[/b]!

After the Oculus Rift launch in December, we worked hard to bring our parachuting experience to HTC Vive and Windows Mixed Reality as well.

Can't wait to hear what you think about it!

KR Games team

notes.title: SkydiVeR is coming to Steam February 28th!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[b]One week away from the official launch day, are you ready?[/b]

Parachuting is something everybody has ever wished in his life, at least once, and in SkidiVeR you will be able to experiment the inebriating sensation of what it means like!

Stay tuned for updates and follow us on Facebook ;)

KR Games team

notes.title: SkydiVeR is coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are really excited to announce that SkydiVeR is finally ready for HTC Vive and Windows Mixed Reality, and will be coming soon to Steam!

You will enjoy this breathtaking experience, already available on the Oculus store for Rift and Go, straight from your home, launching into the sky and literally fly in this graphically stunning 3D environment, trying to land on a cargo ship in the middle of the Pacific Ocean.

Stay tuned!

KR Games team
